claims: Artemis II launched successfully at 6:35 p.m. EDT on April 1, 2026.
Artemis II launched from Pad 39B, Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
Artemis II is the first crewed moon mission in over 50 years.
The Artemis II crew consists of four astronauts.
The Artemis II mission duration is 10 days.
The Artemis II mission is to test the Orion spacecraft systems before a future landing mission.
Artemis II is a crewed flyby.
Artemis III (Moon Landing) is planned for 2027.
The Artemis II crew consists of NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II crew will orbit the moon.
The Artemis II crew will test the spacecraft's life support systems.
